messages:
maya: Heads up — billing spike. Looks like ~12% of our reserved GPU hours in eu-west-1 didn't map to Savings Plan last month. AWS billing shows a $32,400 delta. Anyone able to dig in? :eyes:
juan: Checking now — are these untagged instances or wrong account mappings?
maya: Quick sample: i-0a1b2c3d4e (eu-west-1) has tags Name=redwood-infer-nd, env=prod but missing tag:team=ml. Cost Explorer groups by tag so SP didn't attach.
oliver: That matches a rollout bug — new ASGs from the infer-v2 deploy didn't inherit tags. We changed the tf module last week but old ASGs likely stayed.
katie: Can we retroapply tags and ask AWS to reclassify usage? Also confirm whether those hours were RI vs SP — mixing can be messy.
maya: I ran a quick query to surface missing tags: `aws ec2 describe-instances --region eu-west-1 --query "Reservations[].Instances[?!(Tags[?Key=='team'])].InstanceId"` — found i-0a1b2c3d4e, i-0f9e8d7c6b. I'll open a PR for a one-off scrub script.
infra-bot: tag-scrub job scheduled: infra-ci will run scrub-eu-west1 at 02:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
juan: If we can tag and then raise a billing case with Cost Explorer screenshots, AWS sometimes appliers SP credits retroactively within their window. I'll file the support case.
oliver: Also double-check spot/interruptible vs reserved mapping — moving families can break SP coverage. And check ENIs/volumes attached to GPU instances; sometimes the resource mapping in billing is odd.
katie: Proposed action list: 1) run tag-scrub and backfill missing tags (juan) 2) open AWS billing case + attach reports (juan) 3) import old ASGs into terraform and backfill tags (oliver) 4) add pipeline guardrail to prevent missing tags (maya).
maya: +1. I'll also add a small SP-utilization dashboard by tag so we spot this earlier. ETA EOD tomorrow.
juan: Filed support case #1234567890 with Cost Explorer export attached. Linking ticket here for tracking.
maya: Thanks. If AWS declines retroapply, we may need to hedge next quarter commit to cover the delta. Keep updates in this thread.
oliver: Noted. I'll start the ASG import and tag backfill tomorrow morning. :pray:
